candidate_law.name: state security absorption pipeline
candidate_law.setup: Conditional on N recruits admitted in one state-regeneration interval, G0 trainee stock, R0 trained reserve, training rate tau, reserve attrition mu, interval dt, and final deployment Y.

exact_accounting_predictions: At fixed G0+N and dt, graduated mass increases monotonically with tau while remaining trainee stock decreases monotonically.
With no additional recruitment, trainee survival composes exactly across adjacent intervals: exp(-tau*(dt1+dt2))=exp(-tau*dt1)*exp(-tau*dt2).
production_equivalence_required: Pure pipeline/reserve helpers must be bitwise equivalent to the current inline production arithmetic across the stress grid.
The production state-regeneration path must use those helpers without changing event order.
An isolated no-recruitment/no-deployment state test must match the analytic pipeline and reserve transition.
Existing security_recruitment_flows_through_training_before_replacement regression must continue to pass.
claim_boundary: SL10 is a stock-flow theorem of Pineland's synthetic state-security regeneration process. It is not an empirical estimate of real police or military training times.
